text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program will provide different kinds of courses for international students. Student does not need to have Chinese language skills, and this program has a h igh school education requirement. The Duration of this program is 4 years, and the tuition fee will be 20,000 (CNY). When you finish this program you will be awarded a Bachelor's Degree. This program is taught in English. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This Program aims to provide our students with solid knowledge of English language, professional skills, and cultural quality. Communication and Information Systems Qualification Awarded Bachelor's Degree Faculty Faculty of Foreign Languages Discipline Foreign Languages & Literature Specialty English Linguistics and Literature Teaching Language English Duration of Study 4 Years Academic Requirements High school education Chinese Language Skills Required N/A Tuition Fees Per Year 20,000 (CNY) Type of Scholarship Zhejiang Government Scholarship; Ningbo Government Scholarship; Ningbo University Scholarship Program Description The program aims to provide our students with solid knowledge of English language, professional skills, and cultural quality. It also prepares graduates for careers as English-language professionals in the fields of teaching, academic research, translation, international affairs, international trade & business, culture, press & publishing, education, media and communications, finance, and banking. We have been dedicated to providing our students with a humanistic and holistic education that enables them to think globally and innovatively and make practical use of their professional knowledge and skills for smooth intercultural communication. 3. Ningbo University Introduction Editor Notes: NBU is located in the historical and cultural city of Ningbo of Zhejiang Province, bordering on the East China Sea. The University is located in the historical and cultural city of Ningbo of Zhejiang Province, bordering on the East China Sea. Ningbo has long been acclaimed as a thriving commercial port and a shining pearl near the East Sea, and it has gradually grown to be a major city in the Southern part of the Yangtze Delta and a key trading port in East China. The University has five campuses, covering an area of over 160 hectares, with a floor space totaling 560,000 square meters. The main campus, adjacent to Ningzhen Road in the north and Yongjiang River in the south, offers wide space for study and research with magnificent buildings and pleasant lawns and greenery. Learn More >> 4. Faculty and Staff Editor Notes: Ningbo University has very sufficient teaching resource. The University employs over 2826 staff members including 1843 teachers and researchers, 401 have senior professional titles and 783 have associate senior professional titles, and over 1158 staff hold a PhD degree. It has 7 class-A subjects and 6 class-B subjects rated first-class provincially. According to ESI (Essential Science Indicators) subject ranking, Clinical Medicine, Engineering, Chemistry, Material Science, Plant and Animal are 5 disciplines that go on the list of 1% world-class institutions. 5. Extra curriculum Activities Editor Notes: Rich extra-curriculum activities at Ningbo University will sparkle your boring study time. Ningbo University offers plentiful opportunities for international students to participate in various activities such as Kongfu, Painting, Calligraphy, Dancing, Chess and Traditional Instruments.
